cohort: The study included 315 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants admitted to Essos Hospital, Yaounde, Cameroon, weighing <1500g regardless of gestational age, from two time periods (1998-2004 and 2010-2013).
finding: The overall mortality rate of VLBW infants was 48%, with an improvement seen in infants weighing more than 1000g between the two study periods.
mod_finding: Mortality rate was higher with vaginal delivery (47%) versus cesarean section (20%).
